lines.en: Eight legs walking sound like falling rain.
I walk up walls and need no ladder.
The ceiling is a road too, believe it or not.
My feet are hairy, and they make no sound.
I squeeze through the narrowest gap.
The cave is dark, and I see clearly.
Eight feet per step, and I never stumble.

lines.zh: 我爬到梁上，从上往下看。
lines.en: I climb the beam and look down from it.
My own silk holds me; I will not drop.
There is a draft in the stones, which suits me.
I move lightly; you will not hear me.
I can walk backwards too; let me try.
At the corner, I pause before turning.
I climbed this very wall yesterday.

lines.zh: 我沿着梁走到墙的那头。
lines.en: I walk the beam to the far wall.

lines.zh: 网的边上一颤，我过去了。
lines.en: The web's edge trembles; I go over.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛，一只都不用闭。
lines.en: Eight eyes, and not one of them closes.
I am counting the cracks in the cave roof.
The silk comes out of me still warm.
This place is too bright; I dislike it.
Something bugs under the stone down there.
I grind my fangs and wait for night.
The web is done; now I wait for wind.
There are footsteps above, and they are heavy.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像块石头。
lines.en: When I keep still, I look like stone.
A drop falls on my back, cold and sudden.
This stretch of darkness belongs to me.
I draw my legs in and curl up tight.
Your torch makes all my eyes ache.
You smell of iron, and of sweat.

lines.zh: 你看见我了吗？我就在上面。
lines.en: Do you see me? I am right above you.
All eight of my eyes are on you.
You snapped one of my threads.
Your shadow has fallen across my web.
You are wider than the tunnel; you cannot fit.
That sword in your hand; I counted its edges.

lines.zh: 你呼吸变快了，我听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing quickened, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就进一步。
lines.en: You step back once, and I step forward.
Hiss. Who stepped on me?

lines.zh: 这一下打得我缩成一团。
lines.en: That hit curled me into a ball.
The light stung one of my eyes.

lines.zh: 别打我的肚子，丝在里面。
lines.en: Not my belly; the silk is stored there.
I retreat up the wall; do not follow.
Hiss, hiss; the pain makes my legs shake.
I will remember you for the rest of my life.

lines.zh: 我掉下来了，摔在石头上。
lines.en: I fell and landed hard on the stone.
A few hairs came off, nothing serious.
Stay back; I can still bite.
I do not eat bread; I eat things that fly.
That scrap of meat is far too small.
Do not coax me with rotten flesh; I have a web.
I am hungry, but I do not eat cooked food.

lines.zh: 你把灯拿远点，我就考虑。
lines.en: Move that light away and I will consider it.

lines.zh: 网里有东西，比你的手香。
lines.en: Something in my web smells better than your hand.

lines.zh: 跟着你？除非你把火把灭了。
lines.en: Follow you? Only if you put out the torch.

lines.zh: 我感兴趣的是你脚边的蛾子。
lines.en: What interests me is the moth by your feet.
I catch my own food well enough.

lines.zh: 你晃那东西，像只大虫子。
lines.en: Wave that thing again; it looks like a big bug.
You bumped into one of my legs.
Move aside; this is my wall.
With eight legs, I can squeeze past you.
Do not stomp; I dodge quickly.
You touched the silk; sticky, is it not?

lines.zh: 我们卡在同一个洞里了。
lines.en: Now we are both stuck in the same tunnel.
I will go up the wall; you take below.
One bump and some dust fell off me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太重，地都在响。
lines.en: Your boots are heavy; the floor rings.
Do not press so close; I am not used to it.
Your web is woven tighter than mine.
Two spiders make sixteen legs in all.
I tapped your web three times.

lines.zh: 卵囊要藏在最暗的角落。
lines.en: The egg sac must go in the darkest corner.
You are a size bigger, and I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 跟我来，洞顶有个好地方。
lines.en: Follow me; there is a good spot on the ceiling.
Hold still; let me tidy your silk.

lines.zh: 我们的崽子会从缝里爬出来。
lines.en: Our young will crawl out of the cracks.
This stretch of cave can raise a whole brood.

lines.zh: 你爬墙的样子，我记住了。
lines.en: The way you climb walls, I will remember it.
This strand goes back into my web.
What falls belongs to the web.
I cannot lift it, so I drag it with silk.
This round thing I will wrap up first.
Pick it up? I use my front legs to grip.
You dropped this; I will hang it on my web.
This one is heavy, so I drag it along.

lines.zh: 地上那颗，我早就看见了。
lines.en: That thing on the floor, I saw it long ago.
Two loops of silk and it will not fall.
Do not snatch it; this is my catch.

lines.zh: 有东西走进我的暗处了。
lines.en: Something has walked into my darkness.
It carries light, and I hate that.
All eight eyes fix on it at once.
I crouch low and tense every leg.
It has not seen me, which is good.
This prey is much bigger than a bug.
Dropping from above takes the least effort.
Its back is to me; the chance is here.
I hang one thread first, leaving a way out.
The light at the mouth dimmed; I can move.
It has stepped onto the edge of my web.
I wait for it to take two more steps.
Do not turn around; I am right overhead.
I count each of its footsteps.
It raises a torch, so I withdraw.
A little closer, just a little closer.
I bend my legs and ready the leap.
The thread is already pulled taut.
It heard me, so I must be quicker.
The darkness is on my side.
Its neck is exposed now.
I slide down the wall without a sound.
It runs for the tunnel mouth; I take the short way.
This pounce must not miss.
One bite, and my fangs carry venom.
My front legs pin it down.
It is tangled in my silk now.
That one will stay with it all night.
I come down on it from above!
Stop struggling; it only pulls tighter.
My fangs are small, but very sharp.
It shoves me off, and I lunge again.
All eight legs push at once.
One bite, then I retreat; I do not linger.
Three wide and one high; just right.
I was born in a cave without light.
Stone overhead instead of sky.
My first breath tastes of mold and damp.
In the dark, my eyes light up first.

lines.zh: 我从缝里爬出来，腿还软。
lines.en: I crawl from the crack, legs still soft.
Dark enough here to start a web.
Who lit a fire outside? It is so bright.
I could climb walls from the moment I hatched.
Not much room, but enough to stretch.
Fire! All my legs are curling up.

lines.zh: 从洞顶摔下来，腿都麻了。
lines.en: Dropping from the cave roof numbed every leg.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的眼，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Water fills my eyes; I cannot see a thing.
A blast scattered every thread I had spun.
Something sharp has sunk into my back.

lines.zh: 咒语钻进我的腿，痒得发麻。
lines.en: The spell crawls through my legs, itching and numb.
Too long hungry, and I cannot even spin.

lines.zh: 天上亮了一下，我的眼全花了。
lines.en: The sky flashed, and all my eyes went white.
There is no wall below, nothing to grip.
